# measurement uncertainty

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:measurementUncertainty`](gmeow-measurementUncertainty.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/measurementUncertainty>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

The uncertainty (e.g. ±1 sigma) of a temporal measurement, in the same unit as the measured age.
